## Summary
- add bounded transient ReplayRequired checkpoints with deterministic forward-only reconstruction
- add scrub debounce plus generation-based cooperative cancellation
- add exact VFX transient checkpoint/restore and fixed-step forward replay
- apply the exact Rust 1.97.1 formatting reported by Windows Validation

## Validation
Run GameEngine Windows Validation for the affected scope. No Editor/Launcher visual surface changes are included, so Visual Validation is not required.
